name: Anita George
university: Indian Institute of Information Technology Kottayam (IIIT Kottayam)
tagline: Software engineer. Also does applied AI/ML research.
blurb: Anita George is a Computer Science Engineering undergraduate at IIIT Kottayam (2024–2028, GPA 9.17/10), currently a Software Engineer at theMonks.tech building an agentic data-science platform. Alongside that she has run two research internships — code-mixed Malayalam sentiment analysis at SRM University–AP and indirect prompt-injection detection at RV University — and a related project, TrustHeritage, was presented at CHORDS 2026. She also ships fast outside of work: Cupid's Ledger handled 1,000+ users in a single day, and DelAI won TinkHack 2.0 on graph-based route optimization.
current_focus: digital-authenticity verification for cultural heritage media
philosophy: Anita's work runs two tracks at once: production software engineering and applied AI/ML research, and the two inform each other.
Several of her projects explore how technology can reduce harm, improve accessibility, or verify authenticity — VantaAI, LawGorithm, NeuroBridge, and TrustHeritage all sit in this space.
She is interested in both backend systems (algorithms, APIs, optimization) and frontend systems (component architecture, interaction design, accessibility).
Graph theory and optimization appear repeatedly across her work — both as an engineering tool (DelAI) and as long-running DSA practice.
